name: search-console-health
summary: A Search Console property's health on your own Google account: clicks and impressions now against the 28 days before, top queries and pages, sitemap errors, home page index status, plain findings.

site.note: the property as Search Console names it: sc-domain:example.com, or https://www.example.com/

inspect_url.note: one page to inspect for index status; default: the home page
